name: coverage
//: The repo-level coverage gate: clears the shared profile directory before the crates' instrumented test runs, then merges their profiles and enforces the 95% line/function/region floor over the allowlister crate's sources (src/main.rs and tests/ excluded) once, across every crate tagged coverage:profiles (today the unit and e2e projects). The tag is the one list of profile-producing crates: this project depends on and waits for exactly those, so a change elsewhere never reruns the Rust suites.
